_comment: Hand-kept (2026-09-29, user request: noob-friendly rotations, class spells only). The short leveling rotation a new player follows, per class and fight-lab spec model (the model a leveling build plays in fightlab/run.py). Each list is the fight lab's priority (the module's DESCRIPTION and its casts per kill in research/leveling/rotation.md) in plain words; the exact priority stays on the research pages. Edit when a class module's priority changes. render_modes.py prints them on the leveling player pages.

before: **Mark of the Wild** and **Thorns** up. Levels 10-19: **Bear Form**. From 20: **Cat Form**, then **Prowl** (stealth) up behind the mob.
steps: Levels 10-19 (bear): **Enrage**, **Demoralizing Roar**, then **Maul** whenever you have the rage; **Bash** a mob that starts casting.
From 20 (cat), open from **Prowl** with **Ravage** (from 32; **Claw** before that).
**Rake** whenever it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Claw** to build combo points.
**Ferocious Bite** (from 32) whenever it will kill the mob, at any number of points.
**Rip** at 5 points on a mob above half its health. Before **Ferocious Bite** (levels 20-31): **Rip** at 2 points while the mob has more than 40% of its health.
**Berserk** on the pull whenever it is ready.
Under 30% health while the mob has more than a quarter of its health: leave **Cat Form**, cast **Regrowth**, then **Cat Form** again.
between: Below 70% health: leave **Cat Form**, cast **Rejuvenation** (and **Regrowth** if still below 85%), then shift back; only with the mana to shift back.
Drink when your mana is below 15%: it only pays for shifts and heals. Eat below two thirds of your health when there was no mana to heal.

before: **Mark of the Wild** and **Thorns** up; **Moonkin Form** once you have it (40).
steps: **Moonfire** on a mob above a third of its health, **Insect Swarm** above 40%.
**Wrath** while the mob walks in and whenever nothing below applies: each one stores **Eclipse** charges.
**Starfire** while **Eclipse** has charges, or while the mob is rooted or stunned.
A nearly dead mob: finish it with **Moonfire** or **Wrath**.
Low on health: **Entangling Roots** on the mob, step out of melee, then **Regrowth** (it drops **Moonkin Form**; go back in while you have half your health and the mob still has half of its own).
between: In **Moonkin Form**, stay in it and eat when your health is below half. Before 40: **Rejuvenation** below 85% health, **Regrowth** below 70%.
Drink when your mana is below about a third (35%).

before: Pet out (a cat), **Aspect of the Hawk** up.
Send the pet in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Hunter's Mark** while the mob has more than 30% of its health, **Serpent Sting** while it has more than 40%.
**Bestial Wrath**, **Intimidation** and **Rapid Fire** at the start when they are ready.
**Aimed Shot** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than a quarter of its health.
No other shots on a single mob: the fight lab levels faster skipping Arcane Shot, Multi-Shot and the hawk and keeping the mana.
**Auto Shot** does the rest. Keep your distance: the bow cannot fire within 8 yards. **Mend Pet** when the pet drops below a third of its health.
If a mob reaches you: **Feign Death** to send it back to the pet; when that is on cooldown, **Mongoose Bite** after a dodge, **Raptor Strike** and **Wing Clip** until the pet takes it back.
between: Mend the pet below half its health, drink below 15% mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: Pet out (a cat), **Aspect of the Hawk** and **Trueshot Aura** up.
Send the pet in first and let it hold the mob.
steps: **Hunter's Mark** while the mob has more than 30% of its health, **Serpent Sting** while it has more than 40%.
**Rapid Fire** at the start when it is ready.
**Aimed Shot** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than a quarter of its health.
No other shots on a single mob: the fight lab levels faster skipping Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot and keeping the mana.
**Auto Shot** does the rest. Keep your distance: the bow cannot fire within 8 yards. **Mend Pet** when the pet drops below a third of its health.
If a mob reaches you: **Feign Death** to send it back to the pet; when that is on cooldown, **Mongoose Bite** after a dodge, **Raptor Strike** and **Wing Clip**.
between: Mend the pet below half its health, drink below 15% mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: Pet out, **Aspect of the Monkey** (**Aspect of the Beast** from level 30).
Send the pet in and walk in behind it. No sting from range: the fight lab levels faster without it.
steps: **Raptor Strike** every time it is ready: it replaces your next swing and costs no global cooldown.
Below 40% health while the mob has more than 30% of its health: **Deterrence**.
**Counterattack** after you parry, **Mongoose Bite** when it lights up (after you dodge, or from **Expose Prey**).
**Strider Kick** on cooldown.
**Lacerate** (from level 30) while the mob has more than half its health and you have 80% of your mana or more.
**Immolation Trap** at your feet while the mob has more than 40% of its health.
With **Expose Prey**: **Hunter's Mark** in a free global cooldown while the mob has more than 30% of its health, so your hits can light up **Mongoose Bite**.
**Mend Pet** when the pet drops below a third of its health.
between: Mend the pet below half its health, drink below a third of your mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (**Ice Armor** from level 30) and **Arcane Intellect** up; **Ice Barrier** before each pull once you have it.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: **Frostbolt** while the mob walks in (it slows it) and whenever nothing below applies, but only while the mob has more than a fifth of its health; if the mob would reach you before the cast ends, **Fire Blast** it instead (or wand it until it arrives if **Fire Blast** is on cooldown and **Frost Nova** is ready).

**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of melee; **Cold Snap** resets **Frost Nova** if it has more than 8 seconds of cooldown left and the mob still has 40% of its health; with both down, **Fire Blast**.
**Ice Lance** again and again while the mob is frozen (**Frost Nova**, **Frostbite** or **Fingers of Frost**).
Below a fifth of the mob's health: **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth), an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand. No Cone of Cold at all.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (**Ice Armor** from level 30) and **Arcane Intellect** up; **Combustion** at the pull when it is ready.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: **Fireball** while the mob walks in, and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than about a third (35%) of its health.
**Fire Blast** when the mob would reach you before a **Fireball** lands (**Scorch** if **Fire Blast** is on cooldown and there is time), once it is on you, or when it will kill.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back; **Blast Wave** if **Frost Nova** is on cooldown.
**Ice Lance** while the mob is frozen; **Pyroblast** only at 3 stacks of **Heating Up**.
Mob on you and no control left: **Scorch** (a short cast, pushed back less), while the mob has more than about a third of its health.
Below about a third of the mob's health, no **Fireball** or **Scorch**: finish with **Fire Blast**, an **Ice Lance** or your wand.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (**Ice Armor** from level 30) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: Your bolt: **Frostbolt** until level 40, only while the mob has more than a third of its health; from level 40 **Frostfire Bolt**, while the mob has more than a tenth of its health. Cast it while the mob walks in and whenever nothing below applies; if the mob would reach you before the cast ends and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives.
**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back.
**Ice Lance** while the mob is frozen and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Fire Blast** only while the mob is between a tenth and a fifth of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana; an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand, finishes it. No Cone of Cold.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Ice Armor** and **Arcane Intellect** up; **Ice Barrier** before the pull once you have it.
Gather several mobs (about four) before you fight.
steps: **Frostbolt** the first mob while the pack walks in.
**Frost Nova** when two or more reach you, then walk out of the freeze.
**Blizzard** while three or more are frozen, slowed or still walking back to you.
**Cone of Cold** (or **Blast Wave**) when two or more close in again; **Arcane Explosion** if they are on you and your mana allows.
Single leftovers: **Ice Lance** while frozen, **Frostbolt** otherwise, **Fire Blast** or your wand to finish.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below two thirds of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (**Ice Armor** from level 30) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can; **Presence of Mind** at the pull (your first cast goes out instantly), and **Arcane Power** too while you have more than half your mana.
steps: With **Arcane Wrath**: cast it first on the pull if it will land before the mob reaches you, and again whenever it is ready and there is time.

**Arcane Blast** while the mob walks in: at most two in a row, only if the cast ends before the mob reaches you and costs no more than a quarter of your mana. Each stack gives all your spells spell damage (15% of your Intellect) for 15 seconds.

**Arcane Missiles** as your channel, also once the mob is on you (with **Improved Channeling**, hits do not cut it short), and at once when **Missile Barrage** lights up (after your two stacks, or when the mob is on you).
No Frost Nova: let the mob come and keep channeling. **Cone of Cold** only when the mob is on you and below a fifth of its health, then step back; **Ice Lance** if the mob is frozen.
When you cannot afford **Arcane Missiles**: **Fire Blast** if the mob is on you, else **Frostbolt**; finish with a **Fire Blast** that will kill, or your wand.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below a third of your mana, **Evocation** when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below 40% of your health.

before: **Frost Armor** (**Ice Armor** from level 30) and **Arcane Intellect** up.
Pull from as far away as you can.
steps: **Frostbolt** while the mob walks in (it slows it) and whenever nothing below applies, while the mob has more than a tenth of its health; if the mob would reach you before the cast ends, **Fire Blast** it instead.
**Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up (your Frostbolts give it): free and twice as fast; not while the mob hits you in melee unless it is frozen.

**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of melee; **Cold Snap** resets **Frost Nova** if it has more than 8 seconds of cooldown left and the mob still has 40% of its health; with both down, **Fire Blast**. No Cone of Cold.
**Ice Lance** while the mob is frozen (**Frost Nova**, **Frostbite** or **Fingers of Frost**).
To finish: a **Fire Blast** (not below a tenth of the mob's health) or **Ice Lance** that will kill, or your wand.
**Counterspell** a mob that casts spells.
between: Drink your conjured water below 15% of your mana, **Evocation** when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below 40% of your health.

before: **Blessing of Might** and **Devotion Aura** up, a two-handed weapon.
Before each pull: **Seal of Command** (**Seal of Righteousness** before you have it).
steps: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells: it stands back and casts until you stop it.
Keep your seal up: put it back if it runs out.
**Hammer of Wrath** when the mob is below 20% health.
**Hammer of Justice**, then **Judgement**, when both are ready and the mob has more than 30% health left: **Seal of Command**'s judgement hits a stunned mob twice as hard.
**Judgement** and **Holy Strike** whenever ready. Against a single mob, no Consecration: the tuned rotation never casts it.

Low on health (below a third, with the mob above a quarter): **Divine Protection** and **Holy Light** inside it, or **Hammer of Justice** and heal during the stun; **Flash of Light** below a quarter; **Lay on Hands** below 15%.
between: Heal yourself back to 80% with **Holy Light** or **Flash of Light**; drink only below 15% of your mana.

before: **Blessing of Wisdom** and **Devotion Aura** up, a two-handed weapon.
**Seal of Righteousness** before each pull; **Seal of Command** instead once your build has it.
steps: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells.
Once you have **Holy Shock**: cast it at the mob as it walks in while your mana is above 70%, after **Divine Favor** for a sure critical hit while you are healthy.
Keep your seal up.
**Hammer of Wrath** when the mob is below 20% health.
With **Seal of Command**: **Hammer of Justice**, then **Judgement**, when both are ready and the mob has more than 30% health left (the judgement hits a stunned mob twice as hard).
**Judgement** and **Holy Strike** whenever ready. Against a single mob, no Consecration: the Holy list never casts it.

Low on health (below 40%, with the mob above a fifth): **Holy Shock** on yourself (after **Divine Favor** if it is ready), **Divine Protection** below 30%, **Hammer of Justice**, then **Holy Light**; **Flash of Light** below a quarter; **Lay on Hands** below 15%.
between: Heal yourself back to 80% with **Holy Light** or **Flash of Light**; drink only below 15% of your mana.

before: **Blessing of Might** and **Devotion Aura** up, a one-handed weapon and a shield; **Righteous Fury** too: **Iron Creed** and **Improved Righteous Fury** cut your damage taken only while it is on (the fight lab keeps it up).
**Seal of Fury** before each pull: with a shield it also gives you an absorb.
steps: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells.
Keep **Seal of Fury** up.
**Hammer of Wrath** when the mob is below 20% health.
**Holy Shield** whenever it is down.
**Judgement** and **Holy Strike** whenever ready; **Swift Judgement** right after a **Judgement** for a free second one.
**Consecration** while your mana is above 60% and the mob has more than 30% health left.

Low on health (below about a third, with the mob above a fifth): **Templar's Bulwark**, then **Holy Light** behind its absorb; otherwise **Divine Protection** (below 30%) or **Hammer of Justice**, and **Holy Light** while the mob cannot hit you; **Flash of Light** below a quarter; **Lay on Hands** below 15%.
between: Drink below 15% of your mana; you rarely need to eat.

before: **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** up; **Shadowform** once you have it.
**Power Word: Shield** before a pull only when you start it below 80% health; **Inner Focus** when it is ready, as the pull starts (your first spell is free).
steps: Pull with the instants: **Vampiric Embrace** when it is ready, then **Shadow Word: Pain**.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready, **Mind Flay** in between (it slows the mob while you channel).
**Shadow Word: Death** when one cast will kill the mob, and below 20% health once you have **Early Demise**.
Finish a mob with a hit or two left with your wand; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40% health.
Skip Devouring Plague and Smite: the tuned rules never cast them (the plague costs too much mana for what it does before the mob dies).
Below a third of your health outside **Shadowform**: **Flash Heal**.
between: Drink only below 15% mana, eat below two thirds of your health (**Renew** yourself instead outside **Shadowform**).

before: **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** up.

**Power Word: Shield** on yourself before every pull: while it holds, damage does not push your casts back. **Inner Focus** when it is ready, as the pull starts: your first spell (from level 20 the opening **Holy Fire**) is free and 25% more likely to crit.
steps: Open with **Holy Fire** from range, and cast it again once its burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health (in melee only while your shield holds).
**Shadow Word: Pain** next, and again when it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Penance** whenever it is ready; **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% mana (also to finish a mob one cast will kill).
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit; then your wand.
Skip Devouring Plague: the tuned rules never cast it.

Hurt: **Power Word: Shield** again in melee below 80% health once Weakened Soul is gone (below half at any time), **Flash Heal** below a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
between: Drink only below 15% mana; **Renew** yourself after a fight below 85% health, and eat below 80%.

before: **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** up.

**Power Word: Shield** before a pull only when you start it below 80% health; **Inner Focus** when it is ready, as the pull starts (your first spell is free); **Power Infusion** on yourself when it is ready.
steps: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, then **Devouring Plague**; each again when it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Penance** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 35% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready, at any mana, while the mob has more than 10% of its health (also to finish a mob one cast will kill).
**Smite** in between while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% mana; your wand otherwise, and for the last hit or two.
Skip Holy Fire: the tuned rules never cast it.

Hurt: **Power Word: Shield** in melee below 80% health once Weakened Soul is gone (below half at any time), **Flash Heal** below a third (with **Renewed Hope** it crits more and brings the next shield sooner), **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
between: Drink only below 15% mana; **Renew** yourself after a fight below 85% health, and eat only if you are still below two thirds.

before: **Instant Poison** on your main hand, **Deadly Poison** on your off hand.
Stealth up behind the mob.
steps: Open with **Garrote**.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**; earlier when it would kill the mob.
**Cold Blood** right before an **Eviscerate** at 5 points.
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Blade Flurry** and **Adrenaline Rush** at the start of a fight.
Do not interrupt a caster mob: let it cast and walk in.
**Evasion** below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below 40%.

before: Daggers in both hands: **Instant Poison** on your main hand, **Deadly Poison** on your off hand.
Stealth up behind the mob.
steps: Open with **Garrote**.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points: the mob faces you after the opener, so **Backstab** is out.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**; earlier when it would kill the mob.
**Cold Blood** right before an **Eviscerate** at 5 points.
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell.
**Evasion** below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below 40%.

before: Daggers in both hands: **Instant Poison** on your main hand, **Deadly Poison** on your off hand.
Stealth up behind the mob.
**Premeditation** for two free combo points.
steps: Open with **Ambush**; once fights last long enough for its bleed to pay (the Subtlety build from about level 40), **Garrote** instead.
**Ghostly Strike** whenever it is ready (it also makes you dodge more).
**Sinister Strike** to build combo points; once you have **Hemorrhage**, it replaces **Sinister Strike**.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**, waiting for the energy rather than pressing another builder; earlier when it would kill the mob.
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell.
**Evasion** below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health; if it is on cooldown, **Preparation** resets it.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below 50%.

before: **Lightning Shield** up, **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon (**Windfury Weapon** from 30), a slow two-handed weapon.
Walk in without an opening **Lightning Bolt** (its mana costs more drinking than it saves) and drop **Searing Totem** as you pull while you have more than half your mana.
steps: **Rage of the Farseer** at the start of a fight whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** a caster mob's spell: it interrupts and brings the mob to you.
With 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**: an instant **Lightning Bolt**, once the mob is under 35% health (not on a mob one bolt would overkill).
**Stormstrike** whenever it is ready.
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free: it takes **Stormstrike**'s 20%. It shares that cooldown with **Flame Shock**, which the fight lab therefore never casts on one mob.
Low on health at any point: under 30% drop **Stoneclaw Totem** (or **Nature's Swiftness** and **Healing Wave** if you have it), under 40% cast **Lesser Healing Wave**.
between: Heal back to 80% health with **Lesser Healing Wave** (**Healing Wave** for a big gap); eat if you are still under 80% (out of mana for heals); drink below 15% of your mana.

before: **Lightning Shield** up, **Rockbiter Weapon** on your weapon (**Windfury Weapon** from 30): you swing it whenever nothing else is ready.
Drop **Searing Totem** as you pull while you have more than half your mana, and pull from range with **Lightning Bolt**.
steps: **Elemental Mastery** when it is ready, at the start of a fight on a fresh mob (if your build has it): **Lightning Bolt** and **Lava Burst** cast 0.5 s faster for 15 s.
**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in, as long as the cast ends before it reaches you.
**Earth Shock** when it would kill the mob, or to interrupt a caster.
**Flame Shock** while it is not on the mob and the mob has more than 30% health.
**Lava Burst** whenever it is ready (20% more damage with **Flame Shock** on the mob).
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free.
**Lightning Bolt** in between while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing.
Low on health at any point: under 30% drop **Stoneclaw Totem**, under 40% cast **Lesser Healing Wave**.
between: Heal back to 80% health with **Lesser Healing Wave** (eat if you cannot), drink below 15% of your mana.

before: **Demon Skin** (**Demon Armor** from level 20) up, **Summon Voidwalker**.
Send the Voidwalker in first and let it hold the mob with **Torment**.
Open with **Amplify Curse** whenever it is ready: it makes that fight's **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger.
With **Soul Link**: turn it on once the Voidwalker is out.
steps: **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** once each, none of them on a mob below about a third of its health; **Corruption** only while you have more than 15% mana.
**Immolate** only on a mob above about half its health and while you have more than half your mana.
With **Wrack**: channel it once **Corruption** is up.
**Shadow Bolt** while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you keep the mana for **Fear** and **Drain Life**; your wand otherwise while the dots finish the mob.
**Drain Life** whenever you drop below 60% health, and in place of the wand while you are below 85%.
**Life Tap** in a fight only when the next **Shadow Bolt** would eat into that mana reserve, you are above 60% health and the mob still has more health than one bolt takes.
If a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
between: **Life Tap** back to 70% mana while your health stays above 60%, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** (or **Health Funnel**) when it is below 60%, eat only below 55% health, and drink only below 15% mana (when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**).

before: **Demon Skin** (**Demon Armor** from level 20) up, **Summon Voidwalker**.
Send the Voidwalker in first and let it hold the mob with **Torment**.
Open with **Amplify Curse** whenever it is ready: it makes that fight's **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger.
With **Soul Link**: turn it on once the Voidwalker is out.
steps: With **Demonic Brand**: **Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone and the Voidwalker is hitting the mob.

**Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health; **Corruption** only while you have more than half your mana; **Immolate** only above half your mana too, and not on a mob below about a third of its health.
Your wand is the filler: **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% mana (**Searing Pain** when the mob has too little health left for a bolt), which the dots and brands rarely leave you.
With **Decimation**: **Soul Fire** while its buff lasts (a **Shadow Bolt** or **Searing Pain** on a mob below 35% health starts it).
**Drain Life** whenever you drop below 60% health, and in place of the wand while you are below 85%; **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health.
With **Improved Health Funnel**: **Health Funnel** a Voidwalker below 30% health while the mob still has more than a third of its health and you have more than 65% of yours.
If a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
between: **Life Tap** back to 70% mana while your health stays above 60%, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** (or **Health Funnel**) when it is below 60%, eat only below 55% health, and drink only below 15% mana (when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**).

before: **Demon Skin** (**Demon Armor** from level 20) up, **Summon Voidwalker**.
Send the Voidwalker in first and let it hold the mob with **Torment**.
Open with **Amplify Curse** whenever it is ready: it makes that fight's **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger.
steps: **Corruption** and **Bane of Agony** first while the Voidwalker builds threat, neither on a mob below about a third of its health.
**Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana, the mob has more than about a third of its health and it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.

**Conflagrate** when **Immolate** has about 3 seconds left (at once with 5 points in **Shadow and Flame**, which keeps **Immolate** burning), or to finish a burning mob it would kill; then **Siphon Life**.
Your wand is the filler: **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% mana (**Searing Pain** when the mob has too little health left for a bolt), which the dots rarely leave you.
With **Incinerate**: cast it instead of **Shadow Bolt** on a burning mob. With **Shadowburn**: finish any mob it would kill.
**Drain Life** whenever you drop below 60% health, and in place of the wand while you are below 85%; **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health.
If a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs, until **Torment** takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
between: **Life Tap** back to 70% mana while your health stays above 60%, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** (or **Health Funnel**) when it is below 60%, eat only below 55% health, and drink only below 15% mana (when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**).

before: **Battle Stance**, a two-handed weapon.
steps: **Bloodrage** (above 45% health), then **Charge** in; open with **Victory Rush** when it is up and you are below 90% health.
**Battle Shout**: keep it up (it lasts 3 minutes).
**Execute** first once the mob is below 20% health.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up: after a dodge, or from **Bloodthrill** while **Rend** ticks.
**Mortal Strike** whenever ready.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
Spare rage: **Slam** (only with **Improved Slam**), then **Spearing Strike**, then **Heroic Strike**; keep 15 for **Overpower**, and 30 more when **Mortal Strike** is almost ready.
Two or more mobs: **Sweeping Strikes**, then **Thunder Clap** and **Cleave**.
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below 50%.

before: **Battle Stance**, a weapon in each hand.
steps: **Bloodrage** (above 45% health) and **Death Wish** when it is ready, then **Charge** in; open with **Victory Rush** when it is up and you are below 90% health.
**Battle Shout**: keep it up (it lasts 3 minutes).
**Execute** first once the mob is below 20% health.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up (after a dodge).
**Bloodthirst** whenever ready.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage: keep 15 for **Overpower**.
Two or more mobs: **Thunder Clap** and **Cleave** (**Whirlwind** needs **Berserker Stance**).
between: Bandage below 60% health, eat below 40%.

before: A one-handed weapon and a shield, **Defensive Stance**.
steps: **Battle Stance**, **Charge** in, spend the rage **Tactical Mastery** cannot keep on **Shield Slam** or **Rend**, then back to **Defensive Stance** (with **Vanguard**, **Charge** straight from **Defensive Stance**).
**Shield Bash** a mob that is casting.
**Shield Block** whenever the mob is hitting you.
**Battle Shout**: keep it up (it lasts 3 minutes).
**Concussion Blow** when you drop below half health; **Victory Rush** after a kill when you are below 90%.
**Revenge** whenever it lights up (after a block, dodge or parry), then **Shield Slam** whenever ready.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than half its health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage, keeping enough for **Shield Slam** and **Revenge**; two or more mobs: **Thunder Clap**, **Demoralizing Shout** and **Cleave**.
between: You rarely need to eat or bandage: the shield soaks most of the damage.
